label: Every word on the Projects & portal (Setup) screen

params.name: lede
params.default: The Videos screen needs none of this. Everything here is for DOCUMENTING an application: point the portal at a project — a folder or a Git repository — scan it for screens, and How to Use and the manuals hang off that list. Nothing about your product is hard-coded anywhere.

params.name: done_count
params.default: {done} of {total} done. Nothing here is urgent — the portal works as you go.

params.name: step_address
params.default: Tell the portal its own address

params.name: step_address_line
params.default: On People & access, so the links it hands out work when another site reads them.

params.name: step_project_line
params.default: A name, and where its code lives: a folder on this machine or a Git repository.

params.name: step_scan_line
params.default: Tick what is real, rename what reads badly. That list is what every module documents.

params.name: step_email_line
params.default: On People & access. Unlocks confirmed sign-up, password reset and invitations.

params.name: projects_note
params.default: A project is a name, the code behind it — a folder on this machine or a Git repository — and where it runs.

params.name: scan_reads
params.default: The scan reads {source}, pulled fresh each time,

params.name: scan_note
params.default: and lists every file that looks like a screen a person uses — whatever it is written in: React, Vue, Svelte and Angular components; Django, Flask, Rails and Laravel templates; JSP, JSF, JavaFX and Spring mappings; ASP.NET Web Forms, MVC, Razor Pages, Blazor, WPF and MAUI; Android layouts; Flutter, Qt and plain HTML. Tick what is real, rename what reads badly, delete the rest. A project that ships its own screens.json is believed outright.

params.name: register_first
params.default: Register a project above, then scan it.

params.name: narration_note
params.default: How the portal helps people get a key, and how the voice says your product's names. The portal's own address, name and who may sign up live on People & access.

params.name: help_video
params.default: “How to get a Gemini key” video

params.name: help_video_note
params.default: Shown on Key Management and embedded at the top of the written guide. A YouTube embed address or an .mp4 plays in place; anything else becomes a link.

params.name: lex_note
params.default: The narrator reads this before speaking, so the voice says your product's names properly.

params.name: owner_only
params.default: Only an owner can change these.

params.name: wire_note
params.default: Two ways, both framework-free. Either fetch the links and draw your own button:

params.name: wire_or
params.default: …or drop in the one the portal ships:

params.name: no_projects_body
params.default: A project is the thing you are documenting. Register one and the portal learns its screens.

params.name: delete_body
params.default: Its screens and training links go with it. Manuals and videos stay, but lose their project.

params.name: kind_git
params.default: A Git repository — GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps

params.name: folder_note
params.default: A path on the machine running this portal{where} — not on your own computer. Read only, and only when you press Scan; nothing in your project is ever written to.

params.name: clones_only
params.default: This portal only reads code it clones itself, so point the project at a Git repository. Its owner can allow folders on the server with TV_SCAN_ROOTS.

params.name: repo_note
params.default: The portal clones it shallow into its own data folder and pulls again on every scan. Your working copy is never touched.

params.name: token_note
params.default: A read-only token. Used on the fetch command and never written into the clone.

params.name: windows_path
params.default: That is a path on a Windows computer, and this portal runs on a server that cannot see it. Use the Git repository instead.

params.name: reading
params.default: Reading the project… a Git repository is fetched first.

params.name: scan_result
params.default: {n} candidate screens from {files} files read. Nothing is saved until you press Save screens.

params.name: way_git
params.default: Point it at the Git repository — the portal clones it on its own machine, so nothing has to exist on the server beforehand.

params.name: way_path
params.default: Give a path the server can actually see

params.name: way_hand
params.default: Add the screens by hand, or commit a screens.json in the project.

params.name: save_screens_note
params.default: Saved screens keep their links; a later scan adds to them, it never overwrites.

params.name: screens_saved
params.default: Screens saved. They are now the list every module works from.

params.name: row_remove_body
params.default: This screen comes off the scanned list. Nothing is kept until you press Save screens.

params.name: kind_local_blocked
params.default: A folder on this machine — not available to you

params.name: token_saved
params.default: saved — leave blank to keep it

params.name: cannot_see
params.default: The server cannot see that folder

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.setup.<lang> (for example ui.setup.hi).
